name: GPP AI
notes: v9.1.0.stable: faster server AI audit - rolling pool of up to 8 parallel OpenAI requests (batch 25, max 40) that uses each worker's full time budget; 429s honor Retry-After, pause and halve concurrency (kept across chained workers) then step back up; 5xx/timeouts retry with backoff; failing batches split and requeue instead of stopping the job; ERP Sync panel and Bucket 1 banner show the current parallel/batch level and rate-limit pauses.
